node.title: Re^5: This site is not secure continues
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So far, https://perlmonks.org has been working for me with no certificate issues.

Then it seems you were lucky in the DNS round-robin roulette - a run of [https://github.com/Corion/Perlmonks-Maintenance/blob/master/scripts/perlmonks-server-check.pl|perlmonks-server-check.pl] shows that 209.197.123.153 is still serving up a certificate valid for only perlmonks.com.
